manaNeeded: {2}{W/B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: Elenda has at least three +1/+1 counters on it, plus an additional +1/+1 counter for each time you've cast Elenda from the command zone this game.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {W/B}.
Choose to return Elenda to the command zone from your graveyard.
Elenda dies, triggering its second ability and Felisa.
Resolve the Elenda trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to Elenda's power.
Resolve the Felisa trigger, creating a number of 2/1 Inkling creature tokens equal to the number of counters on Elenda.
Cast Elenda from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B} and commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Vampire or an Inkling, adding {W/B}.
The Vampire or Inkling dies, triggering Elenda's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining Vampire or Inkling.
Repeat from step 1.
